verdict.rationale: Clara's own card controls let you encode some policy: merchant-category, time and day-of-week restrictions via the Card Configurations API, and spending limits that reset daily, weekly or monthly. Its homepage also claims "automated expense reporting, approvals and compliance." However, nothing shows a policy engine that auto-approves in-policy expenses and routes only exceptions to a human, and role-based rules are absent. Missing for 10: role-based policy rules, a documented auto-approval and exception-routing workflow, context-aware policy definitions beyond per-card restrictions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
